events.title: The Stitchline Roadblock
events.description: A barricade of knotted bobbins and taut running-stitch cord stretches across the patchwork lane while hostile figures stir behind the cloth.

choices.text: Turn back down the quiet seam (Leave)

events.title: The Frayed Bridge Watch
events.description: A swaying bridge of braided felt spans a dark ravine, where armed sentries block the crossing until thread or steel settles the right of way.

choices.text: Hold the frayed bridge by force (Fight)
Offer two thread bundles for safe passage (spend 2 scraps)

events.title: The Lanternless Ambush
events.description: Guttering wicks leave a velvet hollow in deep dusk as lurking shapes close around the unlit crossroads.

choices.text: Stand and face the closing shadows (Fight)
Buy a sealed lantern pass (spend 18 gold)
Slip back to the lit road (Leave)

events.title: The Knotted-Yarn Patrol
events.description: Tangled skeins of heavy wool snare the roadside posts while a roving patrol demands a tribute of yarn to clear the path.

choices.text: Cut the snares and confront the patrol (Fight)
Trade a spare yarn scrap to pass (spend 1 scrap)

events.title: The Buttonwall Checkpoint
events.description: A rampart of stacked brass buttons and heavy quilted shields seals the narrow pass against travellers without a stamped token.

choices.text: Purchase a stamped gate token (spend 20 gold)

events.title: The Bellspool Picket
events.description: A chain of oversized brass bells and thread-wrapped spools blocks the moonlit lane; doll sentries turn as one when the bells ring.

choices.text: Ring the bellspool and face the sentries (Fight)
